title: Just reached 100 Wishlists for my game Shadows of Imalor
author: Environmental-Wear13
selftext:
5 Years ago I started with my first game. A fantasy action rpg with some inspiration from the Souls games and The Elder Scroll. I wanted to have a game with lots of rewarding exploration as well as a bit different skill system. Gaining new spells would mainly be done by doing quests for 4 different guilds with their own storylines. Way to ambitious for being a first game of course and it's been really hard getting time to work on it when I also have a family, which is why its taken so long time.

But what's kept me going these 5 years is that I love what I'm doing, getting some nice feedback as well as now getting almost 100 wishlists after soon 2 months without any major marketing, it's not super but I'm happy that 100 people actually wants to play what I've been working on. Since I released the steam page I've also worked on the demo which will release 17th of September.

Since a year ago I started introducing LLMs in my workflow since I'm very curious about new tech and this project is mainly for me having fun. Firstly, coding with LLMs has been very helpful when creating minor puzzles or other scripts. Having the foundation is very helpful indeed. Being a software dev is of course very helpful as well since I know how to guide the LLM into making correct decisions. I also started using Gemini to generate some art which I then finish myself by hand so that it fits my style.

comments.author: kid_dynamo
comments.body: Congrats, thats a big milestone and hopefully the first of many
